paragraphs.bg: Това е семейство Петрови. Иван е бащата. Той е лекар. Мария е майката. Ана е дъщеря им, а Петър е син им.
paragraphs.nl: Dit is de familie Petrov. Ivan is de vader. Hij is arts. Maria is de moeder. Ana is hun dochter en Petar is hun zoon.
paragraphs.en: This is the Petrov family. Ivan is the father. He is a doctor. Maria is the mother. Ana is their daughter, and Petar is their son.

paragraphs.bg: Те имат нов апартамент в София. Апартаментът е голям и хубав. В кухнята има голяма маса и нови столове.
paragraphs.nl: Ze hebben een nieuw appartement in Sofia. Het appartement is groot en mooi. In de keuken staan een grote tafel en nieuwe stoelen.
paragraphs.en: They have a new apartment in Sofia. The apartment is big and nice. In the kitchen there is a big table and new chairs.

paragraphs.bg: Стаята на Ана е голяма и има голям прозорец. Стаята на Петър е малка. Петър гледа стаята си и казва: „Стаята ми е много малка! И аз искам голяма стая!“
paragraphs.nl: Ana's kamer is groot en heeft een groot raam. Petars kamer is klein. Petar kijkt naar zijn kamer en zegt: 'Mijn kamer is heel klein! Ik wil ook een grote kamer!'
paragraphs.en: Ana's room is big and has a big window. Petar's room is small. Petar looks at his room and says: "My room is very small! I want a big room too!"

paragraphs.bg: Мария и Иван мислят. Какво да правят? Но Ана казва: „Петре, ако искаш, можеш да идваш в стаята ми.“
paragraphs.nl: Maria en Ivan denken na. Wat moeten ze doen? Maar Ana zegt: 'Petar, als je wilt, mag je in mijn kamer komen.'
paragraphs.en: Maria and Ivan think. What should they do? But Ana says: "Petar, if you want, you can come into my room."

paragraphs.bg: Петър взема стола си и отива в стаята на Ана. „Сестра ми е много добра!“ казва той.
paragraphs.nl: Petar pakt zijn stoel en gaat naar Ana's kamer. 'Mijn zus is heel lief!' zegt hij.
paragraphs.en: Petar takes his chair and goes to Ana's room. "My sister is very kind!" he says.

paragraphs.bg: Иван, Ана и Петър са на вратата на апартамента. Иван има хляб и вода в ръцете си. „Нямам ключ!“ казва той.
paragraphs.nl: Ivan, Ana en Petar staan bij de deur van het appartement. Ivan heeft brood en water in zijn handen. 'Ik heb geen sleutel!' zegt hij.
paragraphs.en: Ivan, Ana and Petar are at the door of the apartment. Ivan has bread and water in his hands. "I don't have a key!" he says.

paragraphs.bg: „Не е ли ключът на масата в кухнята?“ казва Ана. „Не знам“, казва Иван. Мария има ключ, но тя не е с тях. „Какво да правим?“ казва Петър.
paragraphs.nl: 'Ligt de sleutel niet op de tafel in de keuken?' zegt Ana. 'Ik weet het niet,' zegt Ivan. Maria heeft een sleutel, maar zij is niet bij hen. 'Wat moeten we doen?' zegt Petar.
paragraphs.en: "Isn't the key on the table in the kitchen?" says Ana. "I don't know," says Ivan. Maria has a key, but she is not with them. "What should we do?" says Petar.

paragraphs.bg: Петър гледа баща си. Той вижда хляба, водата и… ключа! „Ключът е в ръката ти, с хляба!“ казва Петър.
paragraphs.nl: Petar kijkt naar zijn vader. Hij ziet het brood, het water en… de sleutel! 'De sleutel zit in je hand, bij het brood!' zegt Petar.
paragraphs.en: Petar looks at his father. He sees the bread, the water and… the key! "The key is in your hand, with the bread!" says Petar.

paragraphs.bg: Иван гледа ръката си. Ключът е в нея! „Ти имаш много добри очи!“ казва той на Петър. Те отиват в кухнята и Иван дава хляб на децата.
paragraphs.nl: Ivan kijkt naar zijn hand. De sleutel zit erin! 'Jij hebt heel goede ogen!' zegt hij tegen Petar. Ze gaan naar de keuken en Ivan geeft de kinderen brood.
paragraphs.en: Ivan looks at his hand. The key is in it! "You have very good eyes!" he says to Petar. They go to the kitchen and Ivan gives the children bread.

paragraphs.bg: Мария е в кухнята и прави вечеря. На масата има хляб и вода. Иван е с нея. Той има кафе в ръката си.
paragraphs.nl: Maria is in de keuken en maakt het avondeten. Op de tafel staan brood en water. Ivan is bij haar. Hij heeft koffie in zijn hand.
paragraphs.en: Maria is in the kitchen and is making dinner. On the table there is bread and water. Ivan is with her. He has coffee in his hand.

paragraphs.bg: Петър вижда кафето и казва: „И аз искам кафе!“ „Не, кафето не е за деца“, казва Мария. „Можеш да вземеш вода.“ „Не искам вода!“ казва Петър.
paragraphs.nl: Petar ziet de koffie en zegt: 'Ik wil ook koffie!' 'Nee, koffie is niet voor kinderen,' zegt Maria. 'Je mag water nemen.' 'Ik wil geen water!' zegt Petar.
paragraphs.en: Petar sees the coffee and says: "I want coffee too!" "No, coffee is not for children," says Maria. "You can have water." "I don't want water!" says Petar.

paragraphs.bg: Ана отива на вратата. Това е приятелката ѝ Яна. „Здравейте!“ казва Яна. „Здравей, Яна! Има вечеря и за теб“, казва Мария.
paragraphs.nl: Ana gaat naar de deur. Het is haar vriendin Jana. 'Hallo!' zegt Jana. 'Hallo, Jana! Er is ook avondeten voor jou,' zegt Maria.
paragraphs.en: Ana goes to the door. It is her friend Yana. "Hello!" says Yana. "Hello, Yana! There is dinner for you too," says Maria.

paragraphs.bg: Мария дава на Яна хляб и казва: „Какво искаш, Яна?“ „Вода, моля“, казва Яна.
paragraphs.nl: Maria geeft Jana brood en zegt: 'Wat wil je, Jana?' 'Water, alsjeblieft,' zegt Jana.
paragraphs.en: Maria gives Yana bread and says: "What would you like, Yana?" "Water, please," says Yana.

paragraphs.bg: Петър гледа Яна и казва: „И аз искам вода, моля!“ Мария и Иван се гледат. Мария дава вода на Петър.
paragraphs.nl: Petar kijkt naar Jana en zegt: 'Ik wil ook water, alsjeblieft!' Maria en Ivan kijken elkaar aan. Maria geeft Petar water.
paragraphs.en: Petar looks at Yana and says: "I want water too, please!" Maria and Ivan look at each other. Maria gives Petar water.

paragraphs.bg: Неделя е. Семейството е на масата за закуска, но Петър не идва. Той е в леглото и не иска да яде. „Петре, какво има?“, пита Ана. „Искам само да спя“, казва Петър.
paragraphs.nl: Het is zondag. Het gezin zit aan tafel voor het ontbijt, maar Petar komt niet. Hij ligt in bed en wil niet eten. ‘Petar, wat is er?’ vraagt Ana. ‘Ik wil alleen slapen,’ zegt Petar.
paragraphs.en: It is Sunday. The family is at the table for breakfast, but Petar doesn't come. He is in bed and doesn't want to eat. ‘Petar, what's wrong?’ asks Ana. ‘I just want to sleep,’ says Petar.

paragraphs.bg: Мария отива в стаята му. Петър има температура. Баща му, Иван, е лекар. Той идва, гледа очите, ушите и устата на сина си и казва: „Това е грип.“
paragraphs.nl: Maria gaat naar zijn kamer. Petar heeft koorts. Zijn vader, Ivan, is dokter. Hij komt, kijkt naar de ogen, de oren en de mond van zijn zoon en zegt: ‘Dit is griep.’
paragraphs.en: Maria goes to his room. Petar has a fever. His father, Ivan, is a doctor. He comes, looks at his son's eyes, ears and mouth and says: ‘This is the flu.’

paragraphs.bg: Иван търси лекарство за деца, но в апартамента няма. Мария отива в аптеката и купува лекарство за Петър. Но Петър не иска да го пие. „Не го харесвам!“, казва той.
paragraphs.nl: Ivan zoekt een medicijn voor kinderen, maar in het appartement is er geen. Maria gaat naar de apotheek en koopt een medicijn voor Petar. Maar Petar wil het niet innemen. ‘Ik vind het niet lekker!’ zegt hij.
paragraphs.en: Ivan looks for a medicine for children, but there is none in the apartment. Maria goes to the pharmacy and buys a medicine for Petar. But Petar doesn't want to take it. ‘I don't like it!’ he says.

paragraphs.bg: Мария прави супа с пиле, ориз и малко чесън. Петър яде и яде, и вече няма супа. „Много е хубава!“, казва той. „Сега мога да пия и лекарството.“
paragraphs.nl: Maria maakt soep met kip, rijst en een beetje knoflook. Petar eet en eet, en dan is de soep op. ‘Die is heel lekker!’ zegt hij. ‘Nu kan ik ook het medicijn innemen.’
paragraphs.en: Maria makes soup with chicken, rice and a little garlic. Petar eats and eats, and then the soup is gone. ‘It's very good!’ he says. ‘Now I can take the medicine too.’

paragraphs.bg: Ана му дава и чаша чай. „За здраве, Петре!“, казва тя. Петър пие чая. Сега вече спи.
paragraphs.nl: Ana geeft hem ook een kop thee. ‘Op je gezondheid, Petar!’ zegt ze. Petar drinkt de thee. Nu slaapt hij al.
paragraphs.en: Ana also gives him a cup of tea. ‘To your health, Petar!’ she says. Petar drinks the tea. Now he is already asleep.

paragraphs.bg: Тази неделя семейството е в Пловдив. Там живеят баба Елена и дядо Георги, родителите на Мария. Те имат стара къща с голяма кухня.
paragraphs.nl: Deze zondag is het gezin in Plovdiv. Daar wonen oma Elena en opa Georgi, de ouders van Maria. Ze hebben een oud huis met een grote keuken.
paragraphs.en: This Sunday the family is in Plovdiv. Grandma Elena and Grandpa Georgi, Maria's parents, live there. They have an old house with a big kitchen.

paragraphs.bg: Баба Елена прави баница със сирене, а Ана ѝ помага. „Бабо, колко яйца искаш?“, пита Ана. „Четири“, отговаря баба. „И малко масло.“ Иван и Мария пият кафе на масата.
paragraphs.nl: Oma Elena maakt banitsa met witte kaas en Ana helpt haar. ‘Oma, hoeveel eieren wil je?’ vraagt Ana. ‘Vier,’ antwoordt oma. ‘En een beetje boter.’ Ivan en Maria drinken koffie aan tafel.
paragraphs.en: Grandma Elena is making banitsa with white cheese, and Ana is helping her. ‘Grandma, how many eggs do you want?’ asks Ana. ‘Four,’ answers Grandma. ‘And a little butter.’ Ivan and Maria are drinking coffee at the table.

paragraphs.bg: Дядо Георги и Петър отиват да купят кисело мляко. Но Петър вижда банани. „Дядо, искам банан!“ Дядо Георги купува пет банана и забравя киселото мляко.
paragraphs.nl: Opa Georgi en Petar gaan yoghurt kopen. Maar Petar ziet bananen. ‘Opa, ik wil een banaan!’ Opa Georgi koopt vijf bananen en vergeet de yoghurt.
paragraphs.en: Grandpa Georgi and Petar go to buy yogurt. But Petar sees bananas. ‘Grandpa, I want a banana!’ Grandpa Georgi buys five bananas and forgets the yogurt.

paragraphs.bg: В къщата баба Елена пита: „Георги, къде е киселото мляко?“ Дядо гледа Петър, Петър гледа дядо. „Няма кисело мляко“, казва Петър, „но има банани!“
paragraphs.nl: In het huis vraagt oma Elena: ‘Georgi, waar is de yoghurt?’ Opa kijkt naar Petar, Petar kijkt naar opa. ‘Er is geen yoghurt,’ zegt Petar, ‘maar er zijn bananen!’
paragraphs.en: In the house Grandma Elena asks: ‘Georgi, where is the yogurt?’ Grandpa looks at Petar, Petar looks at Grandpa. ‘There is no yogurt,’ says Petar, ‘but there are bananas!’

paragraphs.bg: На обяд семейството яде баница на голямата маса. Петър яде баница с банан. „Това е най-хубавият обяд!“, казва той. И дядо Георги взема един банан.
paragraphs.nl: Bij de lunch eet het gezin banitsa aan de grote tafel. Petar eet banitsa met banaan. ‘Dit is de beste lunch!’ zegt hij. Ook opa Georgi neemt een banaan.
paragraphs.en: At lunch the family eats banitsa at the big table. Petar eats banitsa with banana. ‘This is the best lunch!’ he says. Grandpa Georgi takes a banana too.

paragraphs.bg: Семейството е в един малък ресторант в София. Ресторантът е стар, но храната е много хубава. Една госпожица идва и пита какво искат.
paragraphs.nl: Het gezin is in een klein restaurant in Sofia. Het restaurant is oud, maar het eten is heel lekker. Een jongedame komt en vraagt wat ze willen.
paragraphs.en: The family is in a small restaurant in Sofia. The restaurant is old, but the food is very good. A young woman comes and asks what they want.

paragraphs.bg: Иван иска шопска салата и бира. Мария иска риба и чаша вино. Ана иска кюфтета и чай, а Петър иска само кебапчета.
paragraphs.nl: Ivan wil een shopska salade en bier. Maria wil vis en een glas wijn. Ana wil gehaktballetjes en thee, en Petar wil alleen kebaptsjeta.
paragraphs.en: Ivan wants a shopska salad and beer. Maria wants fish and a glass of wine. Ana wants meatballs and tea, and Petar only wants kebapcheta.

paragraphs.bg: Госпожицата идва с храната. Но тя дава рибата на Петър, а кебапчетата на Мария. Петър гледа рибата. „Аз не ям риба!“, казва той. Мария взема рибата и му дава кебапчетата.
paragraphs.nl: De jongedame komt met het eten. Maar ze geeft de vis aan Petar en de kebaptsjeta aan Maria. Petar kijkt naar de vis. ‘Ik eet geen vis!’ zegt hij. Maria neemt de vis en geeft hem de kebaptsjeta.
paragraphs.en: The young woman comes with the food. But she gives the fish to Petar and the kebapcheta to Maria. Petar looks at the fish. ‘I don't eat fish!’ he says. Maria takes the fish and gives him the kebapcheta.

paragraphs.bg: Иван търси сиренето в салатата. Там има краставици, но няма сирене. „Каква шопска салата е това?“, пита той. Госпожицата казва: „Извинете!“ и идва пак с много сирене.
paragraphs.nl: Ivan zoekt de kaas in de salade. Er zit komkommer in, maar geen kaas. ‘Wat voor shopska salade is dit?’ vraagt hij. De jongedame zegt: ‘Sorry!’ en komt terug met veel kaas.
paragraphs.en: Ivan looks for the cheese in the salad. There are cucumbers in it, but no cheese. ‘What kind of shopska salad is this?’ he asks. The young woman says: ‘Sorry!’ and comes back with a lot of cheese.

paragraphs.bg: Сега семейството яде и пие. Иван харесва салатата, а Мария – виното. Ана гледа Петър и пита: „Искаш ли риба, Петре?“ „Не!“, казва Петър.
paragraphs.nl: Nu eet en drinkt het gezin. Ivan vindt de salade lekker, en Maria de wijn. Ana kijkt naar Petar en vraagt: ‘Wil je vis, Petar?’ ‘Nee!’ zegt Petar.
paragraphs.en: Now the family eats and drinks. Ivan likes the salad, and Maria the wine. Ana looks at Petar and asks: ‘Do you want some fish, Petar?’ ‘No!’ says Petar.

paragraphs.bg: Петък е. Мария и Ана излизат, защото в неделя отиват на гости на баба Елена и дядо Георги в Пловдив. Ана иска да носи нова рокля там. Те влизат в един магазин за дрехи.
paragraphs.nl: Het is vrijdag. Maria en Ana gaan de deur uit, want op zondag gaan ze op bezoek bij oma Elena en opa Georgi in Plovdiv. Ana wil daar een nieuwe jurk dragen. Ze gaan een kledingwinkel binnen.
paragraphs.en: It is Friday. Maria and Ana go out, because on Sunday they are visiting grandma Elena and grandpa Georgi in Plovdiv. Ana wants to wear a new dress there. They go into a clothes shop.

paragraphs.bg: Мария намира една дълга рокля. „Харесваш ли я?“ – пита тя. „Не, мамо. Много е дълга“ – отговаря Ана. После Мария намира една къса рокля. „А тази?“ „Тази е грозна.“ „Ами какво искаш тогава?“ – пита Мария. „Не искам рокля. Искам пола и риза.“
paragraphs.nl: Maria vindt een lange jurk. ‘Vind je hem mooi?’ vraagt ze. ‘Nee, mam. Hij is heel lang,’ antwoordt Ana. Daarna vindt Maria een korte jurk. ‘En deze?’ ‘Deze is lelijk.’ ‘Tja, wat wil je dan?’ vraagt Maria. ‘Ik wil geen jurk. Ik wil een rok en een bloes.’
paragraphs.en: Maria finds a long dress. 'Do you like it?' she asks. 'No, Mum. It's very long,' Ana answers. Then Maria finds a short dress. 'And this one?' 'This one is ugly.' 'Well, what do you want then?' asks Maria. 'I don't want a dress. I want a skirt and a shirt.'

paragraphs.bg: Ана взема една пола и една риза и влиза в една малка стая. Мария седи на един стол и чака. Тя слага чантата си на пода. После Ана излиза. Полата и ризата ѝ стоят много добре. „Колко си красива!“ – казва Мария.
paragraphs.nl: Ana pakt een rok en een bloes en gaat een kleine kamer binnen. Maria zit op een stoel en wacht. Ze zet haar tas op de grond. Daarna komt Ana naar buiten. De rok en de bloes staan haar heel goed. ‘Wat ben je mooi!’ zegt Maria.
paragraphs.en: Ana takes a skirt and a shirt and goes into a small room. Maria sits on a chair and waits. She puts her bag on the floor. Then Ana comes out. The skirt and the shirt suit her very well. 'How pretty you are!' says Maria.

paragraphs.bg: После Ана вижда една шапка и едно яке. Тя слага шапката на главата на майка си. „Мамо, тази шапка е за теб!“ Мария харесва шапката и якето. Тя взема шапката, но не взема якето, защото вече има две якета.
paragraphs.nl: Dan ziet Ana een hoed en een jas. Ze zet de hoed op het hoofd van haar moeder. ‘Mam, deze hoed is voor jou!’ Maria vindt de hoed en de jas mooi. Ze neemt de hoed, maar niet de jas, want ze heeft al twee jassen.
paragraphs.en: Then Ana sees a hat and a jacket. She puts the hat on her mother's head. 'Mum, this hat is for you!' Maria likes the hat and the jacket. She takes the hat but not the jacket, because she already has two jackets.

paragraphs.bg: Те отиват да платят. Мария търси чантата си, но не я намира. „Къде е чантата ми?“ Ана ѝ помага да търси. После казва: „Ето я, мамо! Там е, на пода.“ Мария плаща сметката. „Добре, че си с мен!“ – казва тя на Ана.
paragraphs.nl: Ze gaan betalen. Maria zoekt haar tas, maar ze vindt hem niet. ‘Waar is mijn tas?’ Ana helpt haar zoeken. Dan zegt ze: ‘Daar is hij, mam! Hij ligt daar, op de grond.’ Maria betaalt de rekening. ‘Gelukkig ben jij bij me!’ zegt ze tegen Ana.
paragraphs.en: They go to pay. Maria looks for her bag, but she can't find it. 'Where is my bag?' Ana helps her look. Then she says: 'There it is, Mum! It's over there, on the floor.' Maria pays the bill. 'Good thing you're with me!' she says to Ana.

q.nl: Waarom wil Ana nieuwe kleren?
q.en: Why does Ana want new clothes?

options.nl: Ze gaat op vrijdag bij opa en oma op bezoek.
options.en: She is visiting her grandparents on Friday.

options.nl: Ze gaat op zondag bij opa en oma op bezoek.
options.en: She is visiting her grandparents on Sunday.

options.en: Her old dress is too short.

q.en: What does Ana want to wear in the end?

q.en: Why doesn't Maria take the jacket?

Ze kan haar tas niet vinden.

q.en: Where is Maria's bag?

paragraphs.bg: Вторник е. Мария слага дрехите на децата в пералнята. Пералнята започва да работи, но после спира. Мария чака, но пералнята вече не работи, а на пода в банята има вода.
paragraphs.nl: Het is dinsdag. Maria stopt de kleren van de kinderen in de wasmachine. De wasmachine begint te draaien, maar stopt dan. Maria wacht, maar de wasmachine doet het niet meer, en op de vloer van de badkamer staat water.
paragraphs.en: It is Tuesday. Maria puts the children's clothes in the washing machine. The washing machine starts working, but then it stops. Maria waits, but the washing machine doesn't work any more, and there is water on the bathroom floor.

paragraphs.bg: Иван е в болницата и Мария не знае какво да прави. „Мамо, господин Стоянов може да ни помогне“ – казва Ана. Господин Стоянов е старият им съсед и знае много за перални. Ана излиза и се връща с него.
paragraphs.nl: Ivan is in het ziekenhuis en Maria weet niet wat ze moet doen. ‘Mam, meneer Stojanov kan ons helpen,’ zegt Ana. Meneer Stojanov is hun oude buurman en hij weet veel van wasmachines. Ana gaat naar buiten en komt met hem terug.
paragraphs.en: Ivan is at the hospital and Maria doesn't know what to do. 'Mum, Mr Stoyanov can help us,' says Ana. Mr Stoyanov is their old neighbour and he knows a lot about washing machines. Ana goes out and comes back with him.

paragraphs.bg: Господин Стоянов е стар и нисък, но още е силен. Той слага очилата си и гледа пералнята. Търси дълго. После казва: „Ето го!“ В ръката си държи един малък чорап.
paragraphs.nl: Meneer Stojanov is oud en klein, maar nog sterk. Hij zet zijn bril op en bekijkt de wasmachine. Hij zoekt lang. Dan zegt hij: ‘Hier is het!’ In zijn hand houdt hij een kleine sok.
paragraphs.en: Mr Stoyanov is old and short, but still strong. He puts on his glasses and looks at the washing machine. He searches for a long time. Then he says: 'Here it is!' In his hand he holds a small sock.

paragraphs.bg: „Чий е този чорап?“ – пита съседът. „На брат ми Петър е“ – казва Ана. „Ами… аз го търся от понеделник!“ – казва Петър. Сега пералнята пак работи. Ана и Петър помагат на мама с водата на пода.
paragraphs.nl: ‘Van wie is deze sok?’ vraagt de buurman. ‘Van mijn broer Petar,’ zegt Ana. ‘Eh… die zoek ik al sinds maandag!’ zegt Petar. Nu draait de wasmachine weer. Ana en Petar helpen mama met het water op de vloer.
paragraphs.en: 'Whose sock is this?' asks the neighbour. 'It's my brother Petar's,' says Ana. 'Um… I've been looking for it since Monday!' says Petar. Now the washing machine works again. Ana and Petar help Mum with the water on the floor.

paragraphs.bg: После Мария дава на господин Стоянов кафе и баница. „Колко сте добър!“ – казва тя. „Няма защо“ – отговаря съседът. Петър взема чорапа си. Сега той пак има два чорапа!
paragraphs.nl: Daarna geeft Maria meneer Stojanov koffie en banitsa. ‘Wat bent u aardig!’ zegt ze. ‘Graag gedaan,’ antwoordt de buurman. Petar pakt zijn sok. Nu heeft hij weer twee sokken!
paragraphs.en: Afterwards Maria gives Mr Stoyanov coffee and banitsa. 'How kind you are!' she says. 'Don't mention it,' the neighbour answers. Petar takes his sock. Now he has two socks again!

q.nl: Wat is er mis met de wasmachine?
q.en: What is wrong with the washing machine?

q.en: What does Petar have again at the end?

paragraphs.bg: Петък е. Мария е в кухнята и прави вечеря: в тигана има кюфтета, а в тенджерата – картофи. Ана слага чиниите и вилиците на масата, а Петър носи хляба. Иван се връща от болницата и семейството яде и говори дълго.
paragraphs.nl: Het is vrijdag. Maria staat in de keuken en maakt het avondeten: in de koekenpan liggen gehaktballetjes en in de pan aardappels. Ana zet de borden en de vorken op tafel en Petar brengt het brood. Ivan komt terug uit het ziekenhuis en het gezin eet en praat lang.
paragraphs.en: It is Friday. Maria is in the kitchen making dinner: there are meatballs in the frying pan and potatoes in the pot. Ana puts the plates and the forks on the table, and Petar brings the bread. Ivan comes back from the hospital and the family eats and talks for a long time.

paragraphs.bg: После децата отиват в стаята си. Ана лежи в леглото, затваря очи и вече спи. Петър обаче не може да спи. Той лежи и гледа тавана. После слага възглавницата на главата си, но пак не може да спи.
paragraphs.nl: Daarna gaan de kinderen naar hun kamer. Ana ligt in bed, doet haar ogen dicht en slaapt al. Maar Petar kan niet slapen. Hij ligt naar het plafond te kijken. Dan legt hij het kussen op zijn hoofd, maar hij kan nog steeds niet slapen.
paragraphs.en: Then the children go to their room. Ana lies in bed, closes her eyes and is already asleep. Petar, however, can't sleep. He lies there looking at the ceiling. Then he puts the pillow on his head, but he still can't sleep.

paragraphs.bg: Петър става и отива в голямата стая. Там Иван и Мария седят на дивана и четат. „Мамо, тате, не мога да спя!“ „Защо, Петре?“ – пита Мария. „Мисля за баба и дядо. В неделя отиваме на гости в Пловдив, нали?“ „Да, отиваме“ – казва Иван.
paragraphs.nl: Petar staat op en gaat naar de woonkamer. Daar zitten Ivan en Maria op de bank te lezen. ‘Mam, pap, ik kan niet slapen!’ ‘Waarom niet, Petar?’ vraagt Maria. ‘Ik denk aan opa en oma. Zondag gaan we op bezoek in Plovdiv, toch?’ ‘Ja, dat klopt,’ zegt Ivan.
paragraphs.en: Petar gets up and goes to the living room. There Ivan and Maria sit on the sofa, reading. 'Mum, Dad, I can't sleep!' 'Why not, Petar?' asks Maria. 'I'm thinking about Grandma and Grandpa. On Sunday we're going to visit them in Plovdiv, aren't we?' 'Yes, we are,' says Ivan.

paragraphs.bg: „Нека да ти почета малко“ – казва Иван. Той взема Петър на ръце и отива с него в стаята на децата. Петър лежи в леглото си и слуша, а татко му чете.
paragraphs.nl: ‘Laat mij je een beetje voorlezen,’ zegt Ivan. Hij neemt Petar op zijn arm en gaat met hem naar de kinderkamer. Petar ligt in zijn bed en luistert, en zijn vader leest hem voor.
paragraphs.en: 'Let me read to you a little,' says Ivan. He picks Petar up and goes with him to the children's room. Petar lies in his bed and listens while his dad reads to him.

paragraphs.bg: Мария продължава да чете на дивана. После става и отива да види децата. Петър спи. Иван седи на един стол и спи, с очилата на носа. Мария затваря вратата. Сега в апартамента само тя не спи.
paragraphs.nl: Maria leest verder op de bank. Daarna staat ze op en gaat bij de kinderen kijken. Petar slaapt. Ivan zit op een stoel en slaapt, met zijn bril op zijn neus. Maria doet de deur dicht. Nu is zij de enige in het appartement die niet slaapt.
paragraphs.en: Maria goes on reading on the sofa. Then she gets up and goes to check on the children. Petar is asleep. Ivan sits on a chair, asleep, with his glasses on his nose. Maria closes the door. Now she is the only one in the apartment who is not asleep.

q.en: How does Ana help with dinner?

q.en: Why can't Petar sleep?

q.en: What does Ivan do to help Petar?

options.en: He takes him to the sofa.

q.nl: Wat ziet Maria als ze bij de kinderen gaat kijken?
q.en: What does Maria see when she checks on the children?

options.en: Petar and Ivan are both asleep.

paragraphs.bg: В петък Силвия, сестрата на Мария, идва на гости с бебето си, Рая. Съпругът ѝ не може да дойде. Рая е племенница на Мария, а Ана и Петър са ѝ братовчеди.
paragraphs.nl: Op vrijdag komt Silvia, de zus van Maria, op bezoek met haar baby, Raja. Haar man kan niet komen. Raja is een nichtje van Maria, en Ana en Petar zijn haar nicht en neef.
paragraphs.en: On Friday Silvia, Maria’s sister, comes to visit with her baby, Raya. Her husband can’t come. Raya is Maria’s niece, and Ana and Petar are her cousins.

paragraphs.bg: Вече е девет. „Лека нощ!“, казва Мария на децата и ги изпраща да спят. Но Рая не спи. Тя плаче. Силвия я взема на ръце, но Рая продължава да плаче. „Лесно е“, казва Иван. „Аз съм лекар. Трябва ѝ баня.“ Той носи бебето в банята, а Мария донася сапун и голяма кърпа. Но и банята не помага.
paragraphs.nl: Het is al negen uur. ‘Welterusten!’ zegt Maria tegen de kinderen, en ze stuurt hen naar bed. Maar Raja slaapt niet. Ze huilt. Silvia neemt haar op de arm, maar Raja blijft huilen. ‘Dat is makkelijk,’ zegt Ivan. ‘Ik ben arts. Ze heeft een bad nodig.’ Hij draagt de baby naar de badkamer, en Maria brengt zeep en een grote handdoek. Maar ook het bad helpt niet.
paragraphs.en: It is already nine o’clock. “Good night!” Maria says to the children, and she sends them off to sleep. But Raya doesn’t sleep. She cries. Silvia takes her in her arms, but Raya keeps crying. “That’s easy,” says Ivan. “I’m a doctor. She needs a bath.” He carries the baby to the bathroom, and Maria brings soap and a big towel. But the bath doesn’t help either.

paragraphs.bg: Мария дава мляко на Рая. „Дано сега заспи“, казва Силвия. Рая пие малко и пак започва да плаче. Ана и Петър излизат от стаята си. „Какво гърло има това бебе!“, казва Петър.
paragraphs.nl: Maria geeft Raja melk. ‘Hopelijk valt ze nu in slaap,’ zegt Silvia. Raja drinkt een beetje en begint weer te huilen. Ana en Petar komen hun kamer uit. ‘Wat een keel heeft die baby!’ zegt Petar.
paragraphs.en: Maria gives Raya milk. “I hope she falls asleep now,” says Silvia. Raya drinks a little and starts crying again. Ana and Petar come out of their room. “What a pair of lungs that baby has!” says Petar.

paragraphs.bg: Тогава идва господин Стоянов, старият им съсед. „Добър вечер“, казва той. „Извинете! Бебето…“, започва Мария. Но той влиза, взема Рая и я слага на рамото си. После ходи с нея по стаята и ѝ говори: „Виждаш ли, малката? Зле съм с гърлото. Зле съм и с коляното. Пия девет лекарства. Кафе не мога да пия, ракия – само малко…“ Рая го гледа и слуша. После затваря очи. Вече спи.
paragraphs.nl: Dan komt meneer Stojanov, hun oude buurman, langs. ‘Goedenavond,’ zegt hij. ‘Sorry! De baby…’ begint Maria. Maar hij komt binnen, pakt Raja en legt haar op zijn schouder. Daarna loopt hij met haar door de kamer en praat tegen haar: ‘Zie je, kleintje? Ik heb last van mijn keel. Ik heb ook last van mijn knie. Ik slik negen medicijnen. Koffie mag ik niet drinken, rakija maar een beetje…’ Raja kijkt naar hem en luistert. Dan doet ze haar ogen dicht. Ze slaapt al.
paragraphs.en: Then Mr Stoyanov, their old neighbour, comes over. “Good evening,” he says. “Excuse me! The baby…” Maria begins. But he comes in, takes Raya and puts her on his shoulder. Then he walks with her around the room and talks to her: “You see, little one? My throat is in a bad way. So is my knee. I take nine medicines. I can’t drink coffee, and rakia only a little…” Raya looks at him and listens. Then she closes her eyes. She is already asleep.

paragraphs.bg: Силвия, Мария и Иван стоят с отворени уста. „Как го правите?“, пита Иван. „Лесно е“, казва старият съсед. „Когато говоря за здравето си, и лекарят ми заспива. Лека нощ!“
paragraphs.nl: Silvia, Maria en Ivan staan er met open mond bij. ‘Hoe doet u dat?’ vraagt Ivan. ‘Dat is makkelijk,’ zegt de oude buurman. ‘Als ik over mijn gezondheid praat, valt zelfs mijn dokter in slaap. Welterusten!’
paragraphs.en: Silvia, Maria and Ivan stand there with their mouths open. “How do you do it?” asks Ivan. “That’s easy,” says the old neighbour. “When I talk about my health, even my doctor falls asleep. Good night!”

q.nl: Wat is Raja van Ana en Petar?
q.en: What is Raya to Ana and Petar?

options.nl: Hun nichtje: ze is de dochter van de zus van hun moeder.
options.en: Their cousin: she is the daughter of their mother’s sister.

q.en: What does Ivan want to do to get Raya to sleep?

q.en: What does Mr Stoyanov do when he comes in?

q.en: What does Mr Stoyanov talk to the baby about?

q.nl: Wie valt er volgens meneer Stojanov ook in slaap als hij over zijn gezondheid praat?
q.en: According to Mr Stoyanov, who else falls asleep when he talks about his health?

paragraphs.bg: От събота господин Стоянов има нови съседи: семейство от Холандия. Имат дъщеря на възрастта на Ана. Ана вижда момичето на двора.
paragraphs.nl: Sinds zaterdag heeft meneer Stojanov nieuwe buren: een gezin uit Nederland. Ze hebben een dochter van Ana’s leeftijd. Ana ziet het meisje op de binnenplaats.
paragraphs.en: Since Saturday Mr Stoyanov has had new neighbours: a family from the Netherlands. They have a daughter of Ana’s age. Ana sees the girl in the yard.

paragraphs.bg: „Добър ден!“, казва момичето. „Здравей! Как се казваш?“, пита Ана. „Не знам“, казва момичето. „На колко години си?“ „Не знам.“ Как може да не знае името си? „Откъде си?“ „Добър ден!“ Сега Ана разбира: момичето може да каже само това. Момичето слага ръка на сърцето си: „Лиза.“
paragraphs.nl: ‘Goedendag!’ zegt het meisje. ‘Hoi! Hoe heet je?’ vraagt Ana. ‘Ik weet het niet,’ zegt het meisje. ‘Hoe oud ben je?’ ‘Ik weet het niet.’ Hoe kan ze haar eigen naam nou niet weten? ‘Waar kom je vandaan?’ ‘Goedendag!’ Nu begrijpt Ana het: het meisje kan alleen dit zeggen. Het meisje legt een hand op haar hart: ‘Liza.’
paragraphs.en: “Good day!” says the girl. “Hi! What’s your name?” asks Ana. “I don’t know,” says the girl. “How old are you?” “I don’t know.” How can she not know her own name? “Where are you from?” “Good day!” Now Ana understands: the girl can only say this. The girl puts a hand on her heart: “Liza.”

paragraphs.bg: Щом види Лиза на двора, Ана излиза. Ана учи езика на Лиза, а Лиза – езика на Ана. За да говорят, двете използват и ръцете си. Ана гледа устните на Лиза и се опитва да каже същото. Макар че говорят зле, вече се разбират.
paragraphs.nl: Zodra Ana Liza op de binnenplaats ziet, gaat ze naar buiten. Ana leert de taal van Liza, en Liza de taal van Ana. Om te kunnen praten gebruiken ze allebei ook hun handen. Ana kijkt naar de lippen van Liza en probeert hetzelfde te zeggen. Hoewel ze slecht praten, begrijpen ze elkaar al.
paragraphs.en: As soon as Ana sees Liza in the yard, she goes out. Ana is learning Liza’s language, and Liza is learning Ana’s. To talk, the two of them also use their hands. Ana watches Liza’s lips and tries to say the same thing. Although they speak badly, they already understand each other.

paragraphs.bg: В понеделник Лиза идва на гости. Ана отваря хладилника и пита: „Искаш ли сок?“ Лиза гледа краката си. „Сок?“, пита тя. Сваля единия си чорап и го дава на Ана. Ана стои с чорапа в ръка. Тогава слага на масата чаша сок. „Това е сок. А това е чорап.“ Двете дълго се смеят. Сега Ана знае: на езика на Лиза сок е чорап.
paragraphs.nl: Op maandag komt Liza op bezoek. Ana doet de koelkast open en vraagt: ‘Wil je sap?’ Liza kijkt naar haar voeten. ‘Sok?’ vraagt ze. Ze trekt een van haar sokken uit en geeft die aan Ana. Ana staat met de sok in haar hand. Dan zet ze een glas sap op tafel. ‘Dit is sap. En dit is een sok.’ Ze lachen allebei lang. Nu weet Ana het: in de taal van Liza is ‘сок’ een sok.
paragraphs.en: On Monday Liza comes to visit. Ana opens the fridge and asks: “Do you want some juice?” Liza looks at her feet. “Sok?” she asks. She takes off one of her socks and gives it to Ana. Ana stands with the sock in her hand. Then she puts a glass of juice on the table. “This is juice. And this is a sock.” The two of them laugh for a long time. Now Ana knows: in Liza’s language ‘сок’ means a sock.

paragraphs.bg: В петък Лиза стои на вратата с малка чанта. „Добър вечер!“, казва тя. „Дано ти хареса!“ В чантата има сок и два нови чорапа. Ана взема чорапите и пита: „Това сок ли е?“ „Не знам!“, казва Лиза и двете пак се смеят.
paragraphs.nl: Op vrijdag staat Liza voor de deur met een tasje. ‘Goedenavond!’ zegt ze. ‘Hopelijk vind je het leuk!’ In het tasje zitten sap en twee nieuwe sokken. Ana pakt de sokken en vraagt: ‘Is dit sap?’ ‘Ik weet het niet!’ zegt Liza, en ze lachen allebei weer.
paragraphs.en: On Friday Liza is standing at the door with a small bag. “Good evening!” she says. “I hope you like it!” In the bag there is juice and two new socks. Ana takes the socks and asks: “Is this juice?” “I don’t know!” says Liza, and the two of them laugh again.

q.nl: Waarom zegt het meisje ‘Ik weet het niet’ als Ana vraagt hoe ze heet?
q.en: Why does the girl say “I don’t know” when Ana asks her name?

options.nl: Ze wil niet met Ana praten.
options.en: She doesn’t want to talk to Ana.

options.nl: Ze kan alleen die zin en ‘Goedendag’ zeggen.
options.en: She can only say that and “Good day”.

q.nl: Waarom kijkt Ana naar de lippen van Liza?
q.en: Why does Ana watch Liza’s lips?

options.nl: Omdat ze hetzelfde wil proberen te zeggen.
options.en: Because she wants to try to say the same thing.

q.nl: Wat doet Liza als Ana haar sap aanbiedt?
q.en: What does Liza do when Ana offers her juice?

options.nl: Ze geeft Ana een van haar sokken.
options.en: She gives Ana one of her socks.

options.nl: Ze drinkt het hele glas leeg.

q.nl: Wat zit er op vrijdag in het tasje van Liza?
q.en: What is in Liza’s bag on Friday?

options.nl: Een glas sap en een oude sok.
options.en: A glass of juice and an old sock.

paragraphs.bg: В събота Ана има силна болка в един зъб. Тя не може да яде закуска и не иска да играе с Петър. Баща ѝ, Иван, е лекар, но не е зъболекар. Той гледа зъба и казва: „Не е хубаво. Трябва да отидеш на зъболекар.“
paragraphs.nl: Op zaterdag heeft Ana erge pijn in een tand. Ze kan niet ontbijten en wil niet met Petar spelen. Haar vader, Ivan, is arts, maar geen tandarts. Hij kijkt naar de tand en zegt: ‘Dat is niet goed. Je moet naar de tandarts.’
paragraphs.en: On Saturday Ana has a bad pain in one tooth. She can’t eat breakfast and doesn’t want to play with Petar. Her father, Ivan, is a doctor, but not a dentist. He looks at the tooth and says: “That’s not good. You have to go to a dentist.”

paragraphs.bg: Мария се обажда на един зъболекар и после двете тръгват. Зъболекарят работи в една стара къща, на последния етаж. Там вече чакат едно момче и една стара жена. Момчето държи ръка на лицето си. Ана седи на един стол и гледа вратата. Страх я е.
paragraphs.nl: Maria belt een tandarts en daarna gaan ze samen op weg. De tandarts werkt in een oud huis, op de bovenste verdieping. Daar wachten al een jongen en een oude vrouw. De jongen houdt een hand tegen zijn gezicht. Ana zit op een stoel en kijkt naar de deur. Ze is bang.
paragraphs.en: Maria calls a dentist and then the two of them set off. The dentist works in an old house, on the top floor. A boy and an old woman are already waiting there. The boy holds a hand to his face. Ana sits on a chair and watches the door. She is afraid.

paragraphs.bg: После една медицинска сестра отваря вратата и казва: „Ана Петрова? Заповядайте!“ Ана влиза с майка си. Зъболекарят е млад мъж с брада. Той ѝ показва един голям стол. Ана лежи на стола и отваря уста.
paragraphs.nl: Dan doet een verpleegster de deur open en zegt: ‘Ana Petrova? Komt u maar!’ Ana gaat met haar moeder naar binnen. De tandarts is een jonge man met een baard. Hij wijst haar een grote stoel. Ana ligt in de stoel en doet haar mond open.
paragraphs.en: Then a nurse opens the door and says: “Ana Petrova? Come in, please!” Ana goes in with her mother. The dentist is a young man with a beard. He shows her a big chair. Ana lies in the chair and opens her mouth.

paragraphs.bg: Зъболекарят дълго гледа зъба. „Зъбът е лош, но мога да помогна. Само че трябва да ти направя една малка инжекция.“ Мария държи ръката ѝ и казва: „Ти си силна. Инжекцията е бърза.“ Така е: инжекцията е бърза, а болката е малка. После зъболекарят работи, а Ана гледа лампата на тавана. Вече не я е страх.
paragraphs.nl: De tandarts kijkt lang naar de tand. ‘De tand is slecht, maar ik kan helpen. Alleen moet ik je een kleine prik geven.’ Maria houdt haar hand vast en zegt: ‘Je bent sterk. De prik gaat snel.’ En zo is het: de prik gaat snel en de pijn is klein. Daarna werkt de tandarts, en Ana kijkt naar de lamp aan het plafond. Ze is niet meer bang.
paragraphs.en: The dentist looks at the tooth for a long time. “The tooth is bad, but I can help. Only, I have to give you a small injection.” Maria holds her hand and says: “You’re strong. The injection is quick.” And so it is: the injection is quick and the pain is small. Then the dentist works, and Ana looks at the lamp on the ceiling. She isn’t afraid any more.

paragraphs.bg: „Това е! Ти си много добър пациент“, казва зъболекарят. „Сега трябва да чакаш малко, после можеш да ядеш.“ Когато се връщат в апартамента, Петър пита сестра си: „Страшен ли е зъболекарят?“ „Не, той е добър. А аз съм силна!“ казва Ана. После тя пита: „Мамо, мога ли вече да ям?“ Мария ѝ дава топла супа.
paragraphs.nl: ‘Dat was het! Je bent een heel goede patiënt,’ zegt de tandarts. ‘Nu moet je even wachten, daarna mag je eten.’ Als ze terug zijn in het appartement, vraagt Petar aan zijn zus: ‘Is de tandarts eng?’ ‘Nee, hij is aardig. En ik ben sterk!’ zegt Ana. Daarna vraagt ze: ‘Mam, mag ik al eten?’ Maria geeft haar warme soep.
paragraphs.en: “That’s it! You’re a very good patient,” says the dentist. “Now you have to wait a little, then you can eat.” When they get back to the apartment, Petar asks his sister: “Is the dentist scary?” “No, he’s nice. And I’m strong!” says Ana. Then she asks: “Mum, can I eat now?” Maria gives her warm soup.

q.en: Why doesn’t Ivan treat Ana’s tooth himself?

options.en: He has to go to the hospital.

title.nl: De kinderen slapen op het balkon
title.en: The children sleep on the balcony

paragraphs.bg: В петък Ана и Петър отиват на гости на баба Елена и дядо Георги в Пловдив. Дядо Георги има стара къща с голям двор и хубава градина. В градината има череши, ябълки, домати и краставици. Децата тичат в двора, а баба Елена ги гледа от прозореца.
paragraphs.nl: Op vrijdag gaan Ana en Petar op bezoek bij oma Elena en opa Georgi in Plovdiv. Opa Georgi heeft een oud huis met een groot erf en een mooie tuin. In de tuin zijn kersen, appels, tomaten en komkommers. De kinderen rennen over het erf, en oma Elena kijkt vanuit het raam naar ze.
paragraphs.en: On Friday Ana and Petar go to visit grandma Elena and grandpa Georgi in Plovdiv. Grandpa Georgi has an old house with a big yard and a nice garden. In the garden there are cherries, apples, tomatoes and cucumbers. The children run around the yard, and grandma Elena watches them from the window.

paragraphs.bg: Горещо е. Дядо Георги работи в градината и носи вода за доматите. „Дядо, искам да помогна!“ казва Петър. Дядо му дава една стара тенджера с вода. Петър тича с нея, но водата отива на обувките му, а не на доматите. „Добре де, и обувките искат вода“, казва дядо Георги. Ана помага на баба Елена в кухнята. Двете правят салата с домати и краставици.
paragraphs.nl: Het is heet. Opa Georgi werkt in de tuin en brengt water naar de tomaten. ‘Opa, ik wil helpen!’ zegt Petar. Opa geeft hem een oude pan met water. Petar rent ermee, maar het water komt op zijn schoenen en niet op de tomaten. ‘Nou ja, de schoenen willen ook water,’ zegt opa Georgi. Ana helpt oma Elena in de keuken. Samen maken ze een salade met tomaten en komkommers.
paragraphs.en: It is hot. Grandpa Georgi works in the garden and carries water to the tomatoes. “Grandpa, I want to help!” says Petar. Grandpa gives him an old pot of water. Petar runs with it, but the water goes on his shoes and not on the tomatoes. “Oh well, the shoes want water too,” says grandpa Georgi. Ana helps grandma Elena in the kitchen. The two of them make a salad with tomatoes and cucumbers.

paragraphs.bg: Когато свършват вечерята, децата отиват да спят. Но в стаята е много горещо и те не могат да спят. „Горещо ми е!“ казва Петър. Тогава дядо Георги отваря вратата на балкона. „Искате ли да спите на балкона? Там е по-хладно.“
paragraphs.nl: Als ze klaar zijn met eten, gaan de kinderen slapen. Maar het is erg heet in de kamer en ze kunnen niet slapen. ‘Ik heb het heet!’ zegt Petar. Dan doet opa Georgi de balkondeur open. ‘Willen jullie op het balkon slapen? Daar is het koeler.’
paragraphs.en: When they finish dinner, the children go to bed. But it is very hot in the room and they can’t sleep. “I’m hot!” says Petar. Then grandpa Georgi opens the balcony door. “Do you want to sleep on the balcony? It’s cooler there.”

paragraphs.bg: Баба Елена донася одеяла, възглавници и чаршафи. Децата лежат на балкона и гледат звездите. „Колко са красиви!“ казва Ана. Петър не отговаря. Той вече спи.
paragraphs.nl: Oma Elena brengt dekens, kussens en lakens. De kinderen liggen op het balkon en kijken naar de sterren. ‘Wat zijn ze mooi!’ zegt Ana. Petar geeft geen antwoord. Hij slaapt al.
paragraphs.en: Grandma Elena brings blankets, pillows and sheets. The children lie on the balcony and look at the stars. “How beautiful they are!” says Ana. Petar doesn’t answer. He is already asleep.

paragraphs.bg: Но после става студено. Ана взема още едно одеяло от стаята и го слага на брат си. Сега и на двамата им е топло. Когато децата стават, дядо Георги вече работи в градината. „Добро утро! Студено ли е на балкона?“ „Малко“, казва Петър. „Но искам пак да спя там!“
paragraphs.nl: Maar later wordt het koud. Ana pakt nog een deken uit de kamer en legt die op haar broer. Nu hebben ze het allebei warm. Als de kinderen opstaan, werkt opa Georgi al in de tuin. ‘Goedemorgen! Is het koud op het balkon?’ ‘Een beetje,’ zegt Petar. ‘Maar ik wil er weer slapen!’
paragraphs.en: But later it gets cold. Ana takes another blanket from the room and puts it on her brother. Now they are both warm. When the children get up, grandpa Georgi is already working in the garden. “Good morning! Is it cold on the balcony?” “A little,” says Petar. “But I want to sleep there again!”

q.en: What happens when Petar wants to help grandpa?

options.nl: Hij maakt een salade met oma.
options.en: He makes a salad with grandma.

q.en: Why do the children sleep on the balcony?

options.en: There are guests in their room.
They want to see the stars.

options.nl: Het is te heet in de kamer.
options.en: It is too hot in the room.
Grandma wants to wash the sheets.

q.en: What does Ana do when it gets cold in the night?

options.en: She goes back to the room to sleep.

options.nl: Ze haalt nog een deken en legt die op Petar.

q.en: What does Petar want the next morning?

options.en: To help grandma in the kitchen.
To help grandpa in the garden.

options.nl: Nog eens op het balkon slapen.
options.en: To sleep on the balcony again.

paragraphs.bg: В събота е сватбата на Николай и Вера. Николай е племенник на Мария, а на Ана и Петър е братовчед. Мария носи нова рокля, а Иван носи нова риза и панталон. Петър също носи риза, но не я харесва. „Ризата ми е много малка на врата!“ казва той. „Не е малка. Ти ставаш голям“, отговаря Мария.
paragraphs.nl: Op zaterdag is de bruiloft van Nikolaj en Vera. Nikolaj is Maria’s neef (de zoon van haar broer of zus), en voor Ana en Petar is hij een neef. Maria draagt een nieuwe jurk, en Ivan draagt een nieuw overhemd en een broek. Petar draagt ook een overhemd, maar hij vindt het niet leuk. ‘Mijn overhemd is heel klein aan de hals!’ zegt hij. ‘Het is niet klein. Jij wordt groot,’ antwoordt Maria.
paragraphs.en: On Saturday it is the wedding of Nikolay and Vera. Nikolay is Maria’s nephew, and to Ana and Petar he is a cousin. Maria wears a new dress, and Ivan wears a new shirt and trousers. Petar wears a shirt too, but he doesn’t like it. “My shirt is very small at the neck!” he says. “It isn’t small. You’re getting big,” answers Maria.

paragraphs.bg: Сватбата е в един голям ресторант. Там има много роднини: лели, чичовци, братовчеди. Ана не познава много от тях. Една стара леля спира Петър и го пита: „Ти чий си?“ „Аз съм син на Мария“, отговаря Петър. „А, ти си внук на Елена! Колко си висок!“ казва лелята.
paragraphs.nl: De bruiloft is in een groot restaurant. Daar zijn veel familieleden: tantes, ooms, neven. Ana kent er veel niet van. Een oude tante houdt Petar staande en vraagt hem: ‘Van wie ben jij er een?’ ‘Ik ben de zoon van Maria,’ antwoordt Petar. ‘O, jij bent een kleinzoon van Elena! Wat ben je lang!’ zegt de tante.
paragraphs.en: The wedding is in a big restaurant. There are many relatives there: aunts, uncles, cousins. Ana doesn’t know many of them. An old aunt stops Petar and asks him: “Whose are you?” “I’m Maria’s son,” answers Petar. “Ah, you’re Elena’s grandson! How tall you are!” says the aunt.

paragraphs.bg: Сватбата трябва да започне, но тогава Николай казва: „Къде е пръстенът? Не мога да го намеря!“ Цялото семейство търси пръстена: в чантите, на масите, в кухнята на ресторанта. Вера чака в красивата си рокля и пита: „Какво се случва?“
paragraphs.nl: De bruiloft moet beginnen, maar dan zegt Nikolaj: ‘Waar is de ring? Ik kan hem niet vinden!’ De hele familie zoekt de ring: in de tassen, op de tafels, in de keuken van het restaurant. Vera wacht in haar mooie jurk en vraagt: ‘Wat is er aan de hand?’
paragraphs.en: The wedding is about to begin, but then Nikolay says: “Where is the ring? I can’t find it!” The whole family looks for the ring: in the bags, on the tables, in the restaurant’s kitchen. Vera waits in her beautiful dress and asks: “What’s happening?”

paragraphs.bg: Петър не търси, защото играе на стълбата с един малък братовчед. И там, на стълбата, той намира пръстена! Петър тича в ресторанта и го дава на Николай.
paragraphs.nl: Petar zoekt niet, want hij speelt op de trap met een klein neefje. En daar, op de trap, vindt hij de ring! Petar rent het restaurant in en geeft hem aan Nikolaj.
paragraphs.en: Petar isn’t looking, because he is playing on the stairs with a little cousin. And there, on the stairs, he finds the ring! Petar runs into the restaurant and gives it to Nikolay.

paragraphs.bg: Николай взема пръстена и казва: „Петре, ти си най-добрият братовчед!“ Сватбата започва и роднините гледат Вера и Николай. А Петър вече не мисли за малката си риза.
paragraphs.nl: Nikolaj pakt de ring aan en zegt: ‘Petar, jij bent de beste neef!’ De bruiloft begint en de familieleden kijken naar Vera en Nikolaj. En Petar denkt niet meer aan zijn kleine overhemd.
paragraphs.en: Nikolay takes the ring and says: “Petar, you’re the best cousin!” The wedding begins and the relatives watch Vera and Nikolay. And Petar no longer thinks about his small shirt.

q.nl: Wie is Nikolaj voor Ana en Petar?
q.en: Who is Nikolay to Ana and Petar?

q.en: What does Petar not like at the start?

options.nl: Zijn overhemd, dat te klein is aan de hals.

options.nl: Zijn schoenen, die te groot zijn.

q.nl: Waarom zoekt Petar niet mee naar de ring?
q.en: Why isn’t Petar looking for the ring with the others?

options.en: He is playing with a little cousin on the stairs.

options.nl: Hij praat met de oude tante.
options.en: He is talking to the old aunt.
He is eating in the kitchen.

paragraphs.bg: Когато Петър има настинка, Иван му дава хапче и казва: „Лягаш, пиеш хапчето и спиш. Сънят е най-доброто лекарство. Няма не искам!“ Но в понеделник настинка има Иван. Той става с хрема, кашлица и силно главоболие. Мария е съпруга на лекар и знае: лекарите са най-лошите пациенти.
paragraphs.nl: Als Petar verkouden is, geeft Ivan hem een pil en zegt: ‘Je gaat liggen, je neemt de pil en je slaapt. Slaap is het beste medicijn. “Ik wil niet” bestaat niet!’ Maar op maandag is Ivan zelf verkouden. Hij staat op met een loopneus, een hoest en erge hoofdpijn. Maria is de vrouw van een arts en weet: artsen zijn de slechtste patiënten.
paragraphs.en: When Petar has a cold, Ivan gives him a pill and says: “You lie down, you take the pill and you sleep. Sleep is the best medicine. There’s no ‘I don’t want to’!” But on Monday it is Ivan who has a cold. He gets up with a runny nose, a cough and a bad headache. Maria is a doctor’s wife and she knows: doctors are the worst patients.

paragraphs.bg: „Имаш настинка“, казва тя. „Трябва да лежиш.“ „Няма нищо“, казва Иван. „Добре съм.“ Въпреки че се чувства зле, той взема душ. Докато той е в банята, Мария говори с децата.
paragraphs.nl: ‘Je bent verkouden,’ zegt ze. ‘Je moet in bed blijven.’ ‘Het is niets,’ zegt Ivan. ‘Het gaat goed met me.’ Hoewel hij zich slecht voelt, neemt hij een douche. Terwijl hij in de badkamer is, praat Maria met de kinderen.
paragraphs.en: “You have a cold,” she says. “You must stay in bed.” “It’s nothing,” says Ivan. “I’m fine.” Even though he feels bad, he takes a shower. While he is in the bathroom, Maria talks to the children.

paragraphs.bg: После Иван се облича и иска да отиде в болницата. На масата го чакат хапче и чаша вода. „Това е за пациентите“, казва той. „Аз съм лекар.“ Той търси чантата си в коридора. Чантата я няма!
paragraphs.nl: Daarna kleedt Ivan zich aan en wil hij naar het ziekenhuis. Op tafel wachten een pil en een glas water op hem. ‘Dat is voor de patiënten,’ zegt hij. ‘Ik ben arts.’ Hij zoekt zijn tas in de gang. De tas is weg!
paragraphs.en: Then Ivan gets dressed and wants to go to the hospital. A pill and a glass of water are waiting for him on the table. “That’s for the patients,” he says. “I’m a doctor.” He looks for his bag in the hallway. The bag isn’t there!

paragraphs.bg: На дивана в хола седи Петър. На носа си има очилата на Иван, а в ръцете си държи чантата му. „Добър ден, господин пациент“, казва той. „Заповядайте.“ Иван иска чантата си, затова влиза. Петър слага ухото си на гърба му, после гледа гърлото, ноктите и лакътя му. „Белите ви дробове не са добре“, казва той. „Трябва да пиете хапчето. Иначе – линейка и операция!“ Ана донася хапчето и чашата.
paragraphs.nl: Op de bank in de woonkamer zit Petar. Op zijn neus heeft hij de bril van Ivan, en in zijn handen houdt hij Ivans tas. ‘Goedendag, meneer de patiënt,’ zegt hij. ‘Komt u binnen.’ Ivan wil zijn tas, dus komt hij binnen. Petar legt zijn oor op Ivans rug en kijkt daarna naar zijn keel, zijn nagels en zijn elleboog. ‘Uw longen zijn niet goed,’ zegt hij. ‘U moet de pil nemen. Anders: ambulance en operatie!’ Ana brengt de pil en het glas.
paragraphs.en: Petar is sitting on the sofa in the living room. On his nose he has Ivan’s glasses, and in his hands he is holding Ivan’s bag. “Good day, Mr Patient,” he says. “Come in, please.” Ivan wants his bag, so he comes in. Petar puts his ear to Ivan’s back, then looks at his throat, his nails and his elbow. “Your lungs aren’t good,” he says. “You must take the pill. Otherwise: ambulance and operation!” Ana brings the pill and the glass.

paragraphs.bg: „Петре, трябва ми чантата. Аз съм лекар!“, казва Иван. „Сега лекарят съм аз“, казва Петър. „Лягаш, пиеш хапчето и спиш. Няма не искам!“ Иван отваря уста, но кашлицата не го оставя да говори. Той гледа Мария. Мария гледа тавана. „Ясно“, казва Иван и взема хапчето.
paragraphs.nl: ‘Petar, ik heb mijn tas nodig. Ik ben arts!’ zegt Ivan. ‘Nu ben ik de arts,’ zegt Petar. ‘Je gaat liggen, je neemt de pil en je slaapt. “Ik wil niet” bestaat niet!’ Ivan doet zijn mond open, maar door de hoest kan hij niet praten. Hij kijkt naar Maria. Maria kijkt naar het plafond. ‘Duidelijk,’ zegt Ivan, en hij pakt de pil.
paragraphs.en: “Petar, I need my bag. I’m a doctor!” says Ivan. “Now I’m the doctor,” says Petar. “You lie down, you take the pill and you sleep. There’s no ‘I don’t want to’!” Ivan opens his mouth, but the cough doesn’t let him speak. He looks at Maria. Maria looks at the ceiling. “I see,” says Ivan, and he takes the pill.

paragraphs.bg: После той лежи в спалнята, а Ана затваря завесата. „Лека нощ, тате!“ „Но е само десет!“, казва Иван. „Сънят е най-доброто лекарство, тате“, казва Петър и затваря вратата.
paragraphs.nl: Daarna ligt hij in de slaapkamer, en Ana doet het gordijn dicht. ‘Welterusten, pap!’ ‘Maar het is pas tien uur!’ zegt Ivan. ‘Slaap is het beste medicijn, pap,’ zegt Petar, en hij doet de deur dicht.
paragraphs.en: Then he is lying in the bedroom, and Ana closes the curtain. “Good night, Dad!” “But it’s only ten o’clock!” says Ivan. “Sleep is the best medicine, Dad,” says Petar, and he closes the door.

q.nl: Wat zegt Ivan als Petar verkouden is?
q.en: What does Ivan say when Petar has a cold?

options.nl: Dat hij naar het ziekenhuis moet.
options.en: That he has to go to the hospital.

options.nl: Dat hij moet gaan liggen, de pil moet nemen en moet slapen.
options.en: That he must lie down, take the pill and sleep.

options.nl: Dat het niets is en dat hij kan spelen.
options.en: That it is nothing and he can play.

q.nl: Waarom neemt Ivan eerst de pil niet?
q.en: Why doesn’t Ivan take the pill at first?

options.nl: Hij vindt pillen alleen iets voor patiënten, want hij is arts.

q.en: How does Petar get his father to take the pill?

options.nl: Hij verstopt de pil in eten.

options.en: He gives him the bag back.

paragraphs.bg: В четвъртък Нина, приятелката на Мария, идва на вечеря. Мария готви от обяд: във фурната има свинско с картофи, а в тенджерата – телешко с моркови. В кухнята е много горещо. Освен това климатикът вече не работи. Иван го гледа, но климатикът не е пациент.
paragraphs.nl: Op donderdag komt Nina, een vriendin van Maria, eten. Maria kookt al sinds de lunch: in de oven staat varkensvlees met aardappelen, en in de pan rundvlees met wortels. In de keuken is het erg heet. Bovendien werkt de airco niet meer. Ivan kijkt ernaar, maar de airco is geen patiënt.
paragraphs.en: On Thursday Nina, Maria’s friend, is coming to dinner. Maria has been cooking since lunchtime: in the oven there is pork with potatoes, and in the pot beef with carrots. It is very hot in the kitchen. Besides, the air conditioner no longer works. Ivan looks at it, but the air conditioner is not a patient.

paragraphs.bg: „Добър вечер!“, казва Нина на вратата. „Айде на масата!“, казва Мария. Тя донася свинското и телешкото. „Какво искаш, Нина: свинско или телешко?“ Нина гледа чинията си. „Мария, извинявай. Аз не ям месо.“ Петър спира с вилицата в ръка. „Не ядеш месо? И кебапчета ли не ядеш?“ „И кебапчета не ям.“ Мария гледа свинското, после телешкото. „Няма проблем“, казва тя. „Не е трудно.“
paragraphs.nl: ‘Goedenavond!’ zegt Nina bij de deur. ‘Kom, aan tafel!’ zegt Maria. Ze brengt het varkensvlees en het rundvlees. ‘Wat wil je, Nina: varkensvlees of rundvlees?’ Nina kijkt naar haar bord. ‘Maria, sorry. Ik eet geen vlees.’ Petar stopt met zijn vork in zijn hand. ‘Eet je geen vlees? Eet je ook geen kebaptsjeta?’ ‘Ook geen kebaptsjeta.’ Maria kijkt naar het varkensvlees en dan naar het rundvlees. ‘Geen probleem,’ zegt ze. ‘Het is niet moeilijk.’
paragraphs.en: “Good evening!” says Nina at the door. “Come on, to the table!” says Maria. She brings the pork and the beef. “What do you want, Nina: pork or beef?” Nina looks at her plate. “Maria, I’m sorry. I don’t eat meat.” Petar stops with his fork in his hand. “You don’t eat meat? Don’t you eat kebapcheta either?” “I don’t eat kebapcheta either.” Maria looks at the pork, then at the beef. “No problem,” she says. “It isn’t difficult.”

paragraphs.bg: Мария и Ана отиват в кухнята и отварят хладилника. Там има кисело мляко, краставици, чушки, гъби и малко боб от вторник. „Значи променяме менюто“, казва Мария. „Нина, надявам се, че ядеш боб!“ „Ям!“, отговаря Нина от хола. Иван е лекар и не може да готви, затова мие чушките и гъбите. Мария ги слага в тигана, а Ана прави таратор. Петър прави айрян: кисело мляко, вода и много сол.
paragraphs.nl: Maria en Ana gaan naar de keuken en doen de koelkast open. Daar staan yoghurt, komkommers, paprika’s, champignons en wat bonen van dinsdag. ‘Dan veranderen we het menu,’ zegt Maria. ‘Nina, ik hoop dat je bonen eet!’ ‘Ja, die eet ik!’ antwoordt Nina vanuit de woonkamer. Ivan is arts en kan niet koken, dus wast hij de paprika’s en de champignons. Maria doet ze in de koekenpan, en Ana maakt tarator. Petar maakt ayran: yoghurt, water en veel zout.
paragraphs.en: Maria and Ana go to the kitchen and open the fridge. There is yogurt, cucumbers, peppers, mushrooms and some beans from Tuesday. “So we’re changing the menu,” says Maria. “Nina, I hope you eat beans!” “I do!” Nina answers from the living room. Ivan is a doctor and can’t cook, so he washes the peppers and the mushrooms. Maria puts them in the frying pan, and Ana makes tarator. Petar makes ayran: yogurt, water and a lot of salt.

paragraphs.bg: На масата вече има таратор, боб, чушки с гъби и айрян. Тараторът е студен, а в стаята е горещо. Нина го опитва: „Много е хубав!“ Петър пие от айряна си и спира. „Колко сол слагаш?“, пита Иван. „Не знам“, казва Петър. След като свършат с вечерята, свинското и телешкото отиват в хладилника.
paragraphs.nl: Op tafel staan nu tarator, bonen, paprika’s met champignons en ayran. De tarator is koud, en in de kamer is het heet. Nina proeft ervan: ‘Hij is heel lekker!’ Petar drinkt van zijn ayran en stopt. ‘Hoeveel zout doe je erin?’ vraagt Ivan. ‘Ik weet het niet,’ zegt Petar. Nadat ze klaar zijn met eten, gaan het varkensvlees en het rundvlees de koelkast in.
paragraphs.en: On the table there is now tarator, beans, peppers with mushrooms and ayran. The tarator is cold, and it is hot in the room. Nina tries it: “It’s very nice!” Petar drinks some of his ayran and stops. “How much salt do you put in?” asks Ivan. “I don’t know,” says Petar. After they finish dinner, the pork and the beef go into the fridge.

paragraphs.bg: В петък на масата има свинско. В събота – телешко. В неделя – пак свинско. В понеделник Петър слага вилицата на масата и казва: „Мамо, и аз не ям месо.“
paragraphs.nl: Op vrijdag staat er varkensvlees op tafel. Op zaterdag rundvlees. Op zondag weer varkensvlees. Op maandag legt Petar zijn vork op tafel en zegt: ‘Mam, ik eet ook geen vlees.’
paragraphs.en: On Friday there is pork on the table. On Saturday, beef. On Sunday, pork again. On Monday Petar puts his fork on the table and says: “Mum, I don’t eat meat either.”

q.nl: Wanneer zegt Nina dat ze geen vlees eet?
q.en: When does Nina say that she doesn’t eat meat?

options.nl: Als ze bij de deur staat.
options.en: When she is at the door.

options.nl: Aan tafel, als Maria vraagt wat ze wil.
options.en: At the table, when Maria asks what she wants.

options.nl: Als ze bij Maria in de keuken is.
options.en: When she is in the kitchen with Maria.

q.en: What does Ivan do to help?

options.nl: Hij wast de paprika’s en de champignons.
options.en: He washes the peppers and the mushrooms.

q.en: What is wrong with Petar’s ayran?

options.en: There is a lot of salt in it.
There is no water in it.

q.nl: Wat gebeurt er met het vlees van Maria?
q.en: What happens to Maria’s meat?

options.nl: Nina neemt het mee naar huis.
Ivan neemt het mee naar het ziekenhuis.
options.en: Ivan takes it to the hospital.
The family eats it for days.

q.nl: Wat zegt Petar op maandag?
q.en: What does Petar say on Monday?

options.nl: Dat hij ook geen vlees eet.
options.en: That he doesn’t eat meat either.

options.nl: Dat hij weer ayran wil maken.
options.en: That he wants to make ayran again.
That the air conditioner works again.

paragraphs.bg: В събота Иван, Мария и децата пътуват до Пловдив. Там живеят баба Елена и дядо Георги, родителите на Мария. Колата е пълна: чанти, сандвичи, бутилки с вода и една голяма торта за баба. Иван кара, а Мария седи до него. Ана чете, а Петър яде банан.
paragraphs.nl: Op zaterdag reizen Ivan, Maria en de kinderen naar Plovdiv. Daar wonen oma Elena en opa Georgi, de ouders van Maria. De auto zit vol: tassen, broodjes, flessen water en een grote taart voor oma. Ivan rijdt en Maria zit naast hem. Ana leest en Petar eet een banaan.
paragraphs.en: On Saturday Ivan, Maria and the children are travelling to Plovdiv. Grandma Elena and Grandpa Georgi, Maria's parents, live there. The car is full: bags, sandwiches, bottles of water and a big cake for Grandma. Ivan is driving and Maria is sitting next to him. Ana is reading and Petar is eating a banana.

paragraphs.bg: Петър пита: „Мамо, стигаме ли вече?“ „Не, още не“, отговаря Мария. След малко Петър пак пита: „А сега?“ „Петре, още сме в София!“, казва Ана.
paragraphs.nl: Petar vraagt: ‘Mama, zijn we er al?’ ‘Nee, nog niet,’ antwoordt Maria. Even later vraagt Petar weer: ‘En nu?’ ‘Petar, we zijn nog in Sofia!’ zegt Ana.
paragraphs.en: Petar asks, ‘Mum, are we there yet?’ ‘No, not yet,’ Maria answers. A little later Petar asks again, ‘And now?’ ‘Petar, we're still in Sofia!’ says Ana.

paragraphs.bg: После Петър дълго не говори. Мария го гледа: „Петре, добре ли си?“ „Не се чувствам добре, мамо. Стомахът ми...“ Иван спира и семейството слиза. Петър пие малко вода и върви с татко си около колата. След малко казва: „Вече съм по-добре.“ Пак се качват в колата и тръгват.
paragraphs.nl: Daarna zegt Petar lange tijd niets. Maria kijkt naar hem: ‘Petar, gaat het?’ ‘Ik voel me niet goed, mama. Mijn maag…’ Ivan stopt en het gezin stapt uit. Petar drinkt wat water en loopt met zijn vader om de auto heen. Even later zegt hij: ‘Het gaat al beter.’ Ze stappen weer in de auto en vertrekken.
paragraphs.en: After that Petar doesn't speak for a long time. Maria looks at him: ‘Petar, are you all right?’ ‘I don't feel well, Mum. My tummy…’ Ivan stops and the family gets out. Petar drinks a little water and walks around the car with his dad. A little later he says, ‘I'm already feeling better.’ They get back into the car and set off.

paragraphs.bg: Сега Иван кара по-бавно, а Петър спи. Около обяд Петър се събужда и пак пита: „Стигаме ли вече?“ „Да, Петре! Ето Пловдив!“, казва Мария. Баба Елена и дядо Георги вече чакат в двора.
paragraphs.nl: Nu rijdt Ivan langzamer en Petar slaapt. Rond het middageten wordt Petar wakker en vraagt weer: ‘Zijn we er al?’ ‘Ja, Petar! Daar is Plovdiv!’ zegt Maria. Oma Elena en opa Georgi wachten al op het erf.
paragraphs.en: Now Ivan drives more slowly and Petar sleeps. Around lunchtime Petar wakes up and asks again, ‘Are we there yet?’ ‘Yes, Petar! Here is Plovdiv!’ says Maria. Grandma Elena and Grandpa Georgi are already waiting in the yard.

paragraphs.bg: „Здравейте!“, казва дядо Георги. Баба Елена гледа внуците си: „Колко сте големи!“ На масата в двора има баница, салата и кебапчета. Мария дава тортата на баба. Петър вече се чувства добре. Той яде баница, после торта, после пак торта. Мария го гледа и казва: „Петре, по-малко торта, моля! В неделя пак пътуваме.“
paragraphs.nl: ‘Hallo!’ zegt opa Georgi. Oma Elena kijkt naar haar kleinkinderen: ‘Wat zijn jullie groot!’ Op de tafel op het erf staan banitsa, salade en kebaptsjeta. Maria geeft de taart aan oma. Petar voelt zich al goed. Hij eet banitsa, daarna taart, daarna weer taart. Maria kijkt naar hem en zegt: ‘Petar, minder taart, alsjeblieft! Zondag reizen we weer.’
paragraphs.en: ‘Hello!’ says Grandpa Georgi. Grandma Elena looks at her grandchildren: ‘How big you are!’ On the table in the yard there is banitsa, salad and kebapcheta. Maria gives the cake to Grandma. Petar already feels fine. He eats banitsa, then cake, then cake again. Maria looks at him and says, ‘Petar, less cake, please! On Sunday we're travelling again.’

q.nl: Waarom stopt Ivan onderweg?
q.en: Why does Ivan stop on the way?

options.nl: Ana wil in de auto lezen.
options.en: Ana wants to read in the car.

options.nl: De taart valt op de grond.
options.en: The cake falls on the floor.

q.nl: Wat zegt Ana als Petar voor de tweede keer vraagt of ze er al zijn?
q.en: What does Ana say when Petar asks for the second time whether they are there yet?

options.nl: Dat ze nog in Sofia zijn.
options.en: That they are still in Sofia.

q.nl: Waar wachten oma en opa?
q.en: Where are Grandma and Grandpa waiting?

q.nl: Waarom wil Maria aan het eind dat Petar minder taart eet?
q.en: Why does Maria want Petar to eat less cake at the end?

options.en: They are travelling again on Sunday.

paragraphs.bg: В сряда Мария се среща с приятелката си Нина в едно малко кафене. Кафенето е пълно с хора. Мария и Нина седят на малка маса до прозореца.
paragraphs.nl: Op woensdag spreekt Maria af met haar vriendin Nina in een klein café. Het café zit vol mensen. Maria en Nina zitten aan een klein tafeltje bij het raam.
paragraphs.en: On Wednesday Maria meets her friend Nina in a small café. The café is full of people. Maria and Nina are sitting at a small table by the window.

paragraphs.bg: Един млад мъж им донася менюто. Нина иска сандвич със сирене и чай. Мария гледа десертите в менюто. „Какви торти имате?“, пита тя. „Имаме торта с череши и торта с лимон.“ „С лимон, моля. И едно кафе.“ Сандвичът на Нина е голям и евтин, а тортата на Мария е малка и скъпа.
paragraphs.nl: Een jonge man brengt hun de menukaart. Nina wil een broodje kaas en thee. Maria bekijkt de desserts op de kaart. ‘Welke taarten hebben jullie?’ vraagt ze. ‘We hebben kersentaart en citroentaart.’ ‘Citroen, graag. En een koffie.’ Nina's broodje is groot en goedkoop, en Maria's taart is klein en duur.
paragraphs.en: A young man brings them the menu. Nina wants a cheese sandwich and tea. Maria looks at the desserts on the menu. ‘What cakes do you have?’ she asks. ‘We have cherry cake and lemon cake.’ ‘Lemon, please. And a coffee.’ Nina's sandwich is big and cheap, and Maria's cake is small and expensive.

paragraphs.bg: Докато ядат, Нина казва: „Мария, имам нов приятел.“ „Така ли? Кой е той?“, пита Мария. „Казва се Стефан. Той е готвач.“ „Готвач! Супер! Къде работи?“ Нина не отговаря. Тя само гледа вратата на кухнята.
paragraphs.nl: Terwijl ze eten, zegt Nina: ‘Maria, ik heb een nieuw vriendje.’ ‘O ja? Wie is het?’ vraagt Maria. ‘Hij heet Stefan. Hij is kok.’ ‘Een kok! Super! Waar werkt hij?’ Nina antwoordt niet. Ze kijkt alleen naar de keukendeur.
paragraphs.en: While they are eating, Nina says, ‘Maria, I have a new boyfriend.’ ‘Really? Who is he?’ asks Maria. ‘His name is Stefan. He's a chef.’ ‘A chef! Great! Where does he work?’ Nina doesn't answer. She just looks at the kitchen door.

paragraphs.bg: Мария опитва тортата. „Много е хубава!“, казва тя. Тогава вратата на кухнята се отваря и един висок мъж излиза с купа в ръка. „Здравей, Мария! Аз съм Стефан. Този десерт е за теб.“ В купата има кисело мляко с череши. Мария опитва и десерта. „Стефан, ти си много добър готвач!“, казва тя. Нина гледа Стефан и казва: „Знам.“
paragraphs.nl: Maria proeft de taart. ‘Die is erg lekker!’ zegt ze. Dan gaat de keukendeur open en komt er een lange man naar buiten met een kom in zijn hand. ‘Hallo, Maria! Ik ben Stefan. Dit dessert is voor jou.’ In de kom zit yoghurt met kersen. Maria proeft ook het dessert. ‘Stefan, jij bent een heel goede kok!’ zegt ze. Nina kijkt naar Stefan en zegt: ‘Dat weet ik.’
paragraphs.en: Maria tastes the cake. ‘It's very good!’ she says. Then the kitchen door opens and a tall man comes out with a bowl in his hand. ‘Hello, Maria! I'm Stefan. This dessert is for you.’ In the bowl there is yogurt with cherries. Maria tastes the dessert too. ‘Stefan, you are a very good chef!’ she says. Nina looks at Stefan and says, ‘I know.’

paragraphs.bg: Мария гледа Нина, после Стефан. „Значи ти правиш тортите тук?“ „Да, и десертите, и сандвичите“, казва Стефан. Когато Мария иска сметката, младият мъж с менюто казва: „Няма сметка. Стефан черпи!“ Мария казва на Нина: „Този готвач ми харесва!“
paragraphs.nl: Maria kijkt naar Nina en dan naar Stefan. ‘Dus jij maakt hier de taarten?’ ‘Ja, en de desserts en de broodjes,’ zegt Stefan. Als Maria om de rekening vraagt, zegt de jonge man met de menukaart: ‘Er is geen rekening. Stefan trakteert!’ Maria zegt tegen Nina: ‘Die kok bevalt me wel!’
paragraphs.en: Maria looks at Nina, then at Stefan. ‘So you make the cakes here?’ ‘Yes, and the desserts and the sandwiches,’ says Stefan. When Maria asks for the bill, the young man with the menu says, ‘There's no bill. Stefan is treating you!’ Maria says to Nina, ‘I like this chef!’

q.nl: Wie is Stefan?
q.en: Who is Stefan?

options.nl: De jonge man die de menukaart brengt.
options.en: The young man who brings the menu.

q.nl: Waarom antwoordt Nina niet als Maria vraagt waar Stefan werkt?
q.en: Why doesn't Nina answer when Maria asks where Stefan works?

options.nl: Stefan werkt in de keuken van dit café.
options.en: Stefan works in the kitchen of this café.
She is busy eating her sandwich.

q.nl: Welke taart kiest Maria?
q.en: Which cake does Maria choose?

options.nl: Ze neemt geen taart, alleen koffie.
options.en: She has no cake, only coffee.

q.nl: Wie betaalt de rekening?
q.en: Who pays the bill?

paragraphs.bg: В неделя Ана търси часовника си. Той е нов, малък и много хубав. Часовникът е от баба Елена и дядо Георги. Ана иска да го покаже на приятелката си Яна, но сега го няма.
paragraphs.nl: Op zondag zoekt Ana haar horloge. Het is nieuw, klein en heel mooi. Het horloge is van oma Elena en opa Georgi. Ana wil het aan haar vriendin Jana laten zien, maar nu is het weg.
paragraphs.en: On Sunday Ana is looking for her watch. It is new, small and very pretty. The watch is from Grandma Elena and Grandpa Georgi. Ana wants to show it to her friend Yana, but now it is gone.

paragraphs.bg: Тя отваря чекмеджето, после гардероба. Там има само дрехи: блузи, пуловери, дънки и една рокля. Ана гледа и на рафта над леглото, но и там го няма.
paragraphs.nl: Ze doet de la open, daarna de kledingkast. Daar liggen alleen kleren: bloesjes, truien, spijkerbroeken en een jurk. Ana kijkt ook op de plank boven het bed, maar daar is het ook niet.
paragraphs.en: She opens the drawer, then the wardrobe. There are only clothes there: blouses, sweaters, jeans and a dress. Ana also looks on the shelf above the bed, but it isn't there either.

paragraphs.bg: Ана отива в банята. Тя гледа до мивката и под огледалото. Няма го. После влиза в хола, ляга на пода и гледа под дивана. Там има една маратонка на Петър и много боклук. Ана бута дивана и гледа под килима. И там го няма.
paragraphs.nl: Ana gaat naar de badkamer. Ze kijkt naast de wastafel en onder de spiegel. Het is er niet. Daarna gaat ze de woonkamer in, gaat op de vloer liggen en kijkt onder de bank. Daar liggen een sneaker van Petar en veel rommel. Ana duwt de bank opzij en kijkt onder het tapijt. Ook daar is het niet.
paragraphs.en: Ana goes to the bathroom. She looks next to the sink and under the mirror. It's not there. Then she goes into the living room, lies down on the floor and looks under the sofa. There is one of Petar's sneakers and a lot of rubbish there. Ana pushes the sofa aside and looks under the carpet. It isn't there either.

paragraphs.bg: Ана отива в кухнята. „Мамо, знаеш ли къде е часовникът ми?“ „Не, не знам“, казва Мария. Тя готви обяд. Ана гледа и в кухнята: на масата, до фурната и в шкафа. Няма го. „Може би Петър знае?“, казва Мария. Ана минава по коридора и чува Петър да говори в спалнята на родителите.
paragraphs.nl: Ana gaat naar de keuken. ‘Mama, weet jij waar mijn horloge is?’ ‘Nee, dat weet ik niet,’ zegt Maria. Ze kookt het middageten. Ana kijkt ook in de keuken: op de tafel, naast de oven en in de kast. Het is er niet. ‘Misschien weet Petar het?’ zegt Maria. Ana loopt door de gang en hoort Petar praten in de slaapkamer van haar ouders.
paragraphs.en: Ana goes to the kitchen. ‘Mum, do you know where my watch is?’ ‘No, I don't,’ says Maria. She is cooking lunch. Ana looks in the kitchen too: on the table, next to the oven and in the cupboard. It's not there. ‘Maybe Petar knows?’ says Maria. Ana walks along the hallway and hears Petar talking in their parents' bedroom.

paragraphs.bg: Тя влиза. Иван лежи на леглото, а Петър седи до него и слуша сърцето му. На ръката на Петър е часовникът на Ана! „Петре! Това е часовникът ми!“ „Аз съм лекар, а татко е пациент“, казва Петър. „А лекарят трябва да има часовник.“ Иван гледа Ана и казва: „Така е.“ Ана гледа брат си и баща си. „Добре, лекарю. Но после ми го даваш, нали?“
paragraphs.nl: Ze gaat naar binnen. Ivan ligt op het bed en Petar zit naast hem en luistert naar zijn hart. Om Petars pols zit het horloge van Ana! ‘Petar! Dat is mijn horloge!’ ‘Ik ben dokter en papa is de patiënt,’ zegt Petar. ‘En een dokter moet een horloge hebben.’ Ivan kijkt naar Ana en zegt: ‘Dat klopt.’ Ana kijkt naar haar broer en haar vader. ‘Goed, dokter. Maar straks geef je het me terug, hè?’
paragraphs.en: She goes in. Ivan is lying on the bed, and Petar is sitting next to him, listening to his heart. On Petar's wrist is Ana's watch! ‘Petar! That's my watch!’ ‘I'm the doctor and Dad is the patient,’ says Petar. ‘And a doctor has to have a watch.’ Ivan looks at Ana and says, ‘That's true.’ Ana looks at her brother and her father. ‘All right, doctor. But afterwards you give it back to me, OK?’

q.nl: Van wie heeft Ana het horloge gekregen?

paragraphs.bg: В събота Иван и Мария местят мебелите в спалнята, защото имат нов гардероб. Той още лежи на пода в коридора, а Иван държи инструкциите. „Много е просто“, казва той. Мария взема инструкциите и дълго ги гледа. „Просто ли? За мен е много сложно. Трябва да ги следваме.“ Но преди това трябва да преместят стария гардероб. Мария моли децата да помогнат.
paragraphs.nl: Op zaterdag verplaatsen Ivan en Maria de meubels in de slaapkamer, omdat ze een nieuwe kledingkast hebben. Die ligt nog op de vloer in de gang en Ivan houdt de instructies vast. ‘Het is heel eenvoudig,’ zegt hij. Maria pakt de instructies en kijkt er lang naar. ‘Eenvoudig? Voor mij is het heel ingewikkeld. We moeten ze volgen.’ Maar eerst moeten ze de oude kledingkast verplaatsen. Maria vraagt de kinderen om te helpen.
paragraphs.en: On Saturday Ivan and Maria are moving the furniture in the bedroom, because they have a new wardrobe. It is still lying on the floor in the hallway, and Ivan is holding the instructions. ‘It's very simple,’ he says. Maria takes the instructions and looks at them for a long time. ‘Simple? To me it's very complicated. We have to follow them.’ But before that they have to move the old wardrobe. Maria asks the children to help.

paragraphs.bg: Старият гардероб е голям и висок, а спалнята е малка. Иван го бута с рамо, Мария и Ана бутат с ръце, а Петър бута с главата си. Гардеробът се мести трудно. Въпреки болката в гърба Иван продължава да бута. След малко зад гардероба се вижда подът. Там има много боклук. Но не само боклук.
paragraphs.nl: De oude kledingkast is groot en hoog, en de slaapkamer is klein. Ivan duwt met zijn schouder, Maria en Ana duwen met hun handen en Petar duwt met zijn hoofd. De kast beweegt maar moeizaam. Ondanks de pijn in zijn rug blijft Ivan duwen. Even later is achter de kast de vloer te zien. Daar ligt veel rommel. Maar niet alleen rommel.
paragraphs.en: The old wardrobe is big and tall, and the bedroom is small. Ivan pushes it with his shoulder, Maria and Ana push with their hands, and Petar pushes with his head. The wardrobe moves only with difficulty. Despite the pain in his back Ivan keeps pushing. A little later the floor can be seen behind the wardrobe. There is a lot of rubbish there. But not only rubbish.

paragraphs.bg: Петър отива зад гардероба и се връща с един стар ботуш. „Това е ботушът ми!“, казва Иван. „От две години го търся!“ После Ана намира малък сандал и слага крака си в него. Кракът ѝ не влиза. „Сандалът ми! Хубав е, но вече е малък за мен“, казва тя. А ето и една ръкавица. „Ръкавицата ми!“, казва Мария. „От три години в чекмеджето имам само една.“
paragraphs.nl: Petar gaat achter de kast en komt terug met een oude laars. ‘Dat is mijn laars!’ zegt Ivan. ‘Die zoek ik al twee jaar!’ Daarna vindt Ana een kleine sandaal en steekt haar voet erin. Haar voet past er niet in. ‘Mijn sandaal! Hij is mooi, maar hij is nu te klein voor me,’ zegt ze. En daar is ook nog een handschoen. ‘Mijn handschoen!’ zegt Maria. ‘Al drie jaar heb ik er in de la maar één.’
paragraphs.en: Petar goes behind the wardrobe and comes back with an old boot. ‘That's my boot!’ says Ivan. ‘I've been looking for it for two years!’ Then Ana finds a small sandal and puts her foot in it. Her foot doesn't fit. ‘My sandal! It's nice, but it's too small for me now,’ she says. And here is a glove too. ‘My glove!’ says Maria. ‘For three years I've had only one in the drawer.’

paragraphs.bg: До ръкавицата Мария вижда малка чанта. Тя я отваря. В нея има красив шал. Мария го гледа, после гледа Иван. „Иване, за кого е този шал?“ Иван дълго гледа в пода. „За теб е“, казва той. „За рождения ти ден.“ „Кой рожден ден?“, пита Мария. „Онзи преди три години“, казва Иван. „Три години го търся!“
paragraphs.nl: Naast de handschoen ziet Maria een klein tasje. Ze maakt het open. Er zit een mooie sjaal in. Maria kijkt ernaar en kijkt dan naar Ivan. ‘Ivan, voor wie is deze sjaal?’ Ivan kijkt lang naar de vloer. ‘Hij is voor jou,’ zegt hij. ‘Voor je verjaardag.’ ‘Welke verjaardag?’ vraagt Maria. ‘Die van drie jaar geleden,’ zegt Ivan. ‘Ik zoek hem al drie jaar!’
paragraphs.en: Next to the glove Maria sees a small bag. She opens it. Inside there is a beautiful scarf. Maria looks at it, then looks at Ivan. ‘Ivan, who is this scarf for?’ Ivan looks at the floor for a long time. ‘It's for you,’ he says. ‘For your birthday.’ ‘Which birthday?’ asks Maria. ‘The one three years ago,’ says Ivan. ‘I've been looking for it for three years!’

paragraphs.bg: Мария започва да се смее и слага шала около врата си. „Много е красив. Благодаря ти, Иване!“ После пак гледа Иван. „А зад дивана в хола какво има?“ „Не знам“, казва Иван. Но Петър вече е в хола и бута дивана. А новият гардероб още лежи в коридора.
paragraphs.nl: Maria begint te lachen en doet de sjaal om haar hals. ‘Hij is heel mooi. Dank je, Ivan!’ Dan kijkt ze Ivan weer aan. ‘En wat ligt er achter de bank in de woonkamer?’ ‘Ik weet het niet,’ zegt Ivan. Maar Petar is al in de woonkamer en duwt tegen de bank. En de nieuwe kledingkast ligt nog steeds in de gang.
paragraphs.en: Maria starts to laugh and puts the scarf around her neck. ‘It's very beautiful. Thank you, Ivan!’ Then she looks at Ivan again. ‘And what is behind the sofa in the living room?’ ‘I don't know,’ says Ivan. But Petar is already in the living room, pushing the sofa. And the new wardrobe is still lying in the hallway.
